title: QUIZ - 12
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Convert a fraction to a decimal to combine it with another decimal value
questions.question: Calculate (round to two decimal places if needed): \( 7/8 \times 6.55 \)
questions.explanation: Convert \( \frac{7}{8} \) to a decimal: 0.8750. Then multiply with 6.55: 5.7313, which rounds to 5.73.
questions.hint: Convert the fraction to a decimal first, then perform the operation.

questions.learningObjective: Evaluate an expression mixing fractions and decimals using order of operations
questions.question: Evaluate (round to two decimal places): \( 4/4 \times 1.42 - 6/9 \)
questions.explanation: Convert both fractions to decimals: \( 1 \) \(\approx 1.000\) and \( \frac{2}{3} \) \(\approx 0.667\). Following order of operations, \(1.000 \times 1.42 = 1.420\), then subtract 0.667 to get approximately 0.75.
questions.hint: Convert every fraction to a decimal, then follow the order of operations.

questions.learningObjective: Combine a fractional length and a decimal length in a real-world context
questions.question: A carpenter has a pipe that is 17.11 meters long and cuts off another piece that is \( \frac{3}{2} \) meters long, joining them end to end. What is the total length in meters (rounded to two decimal places)?
questions.explanation: Convert \( \frac{3}{2} \) to a decimal (1.50) and add it to 17.11: 18.61 meters.
questions.hint: Convert the fractional length to a decimal, then add the two lengths together.
